_docs: CLI parameters always override config file values. Never commit real PATs here.
_pat_note: Preferred: set ADO_PAT and GH_PAT as environment variables or use the <ado-variable-group> ADO variable group. Only set plain-text PATs here in ephemeral, non-shared CI environments.
_flags_note: Each key matches a -Switch parameter on Invoke-GHEMigration.ps1.
_bp_note: Path to branch protection JSON. Empty = use built-in enterprise default.
_custom_properties_note: Optional GitHub custom-properties key/value pairs applied to every successfully migrated repo post-migration. Leave empty ({}) to skip. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
